decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range is a branded line the firm has publicly committed to and built on as part of its announced push into consumer health, so management will keep investing in it rather than abandon it.
As a visibly launched member of the Trivital family sold in pharmacies, the skin and hair supplement shares brand investment with the line, and weak sales can still be read as slow market build-up.
The joint health supplement was announced as new within the Trivital range and fits the consumer health expansion, so dropping it would undercut the brand commitment.
The immune supplement was publicly promoted as innovative and has gained relevance since the pandemic, giving management good reason to persist.

Although the 2018 valsartan contamination recall damaged the product, management can attribute the setback to a temporary industry-wide supplier issue, and the generic fits the broad generics range it is committed to.
The over-the-counter triptan required regulatory investment, was presented on a page of its own, and supports the announced broadening into consumer health, so management will persist with it.
